name: wisteria
notes: vine: Wisteria: a woody vine hung with long racemes, over trees and down cliffs. It comes in three colours, each cluster one of them: violet, lilac and a rare white. v3: the colours are morphs rather than the one lilac material (not drawn yet). v2: was a weeping tree; worlds that had it plant flowering_cherry instead.

morphs.name: violet
morphs.notes: The deep violet of a raceme's top, the commonest.

morphs.name: lilac
morphs.notes: The pale lilac the racemes fade to further down.

morphs.name: white
morphs.notes: The white wisteria, one vine in ten.
